items.after:
Add the map model and generator, and render the generated grid.

`src/map.js` (new):

- `CellType` — frozen set of cell kinds: `PATH`, `OBSTACLE`, `EXIT`.
- `GRID_ROWS = 15`, `GRID_COLS = 20`, `CELL_SIZE = 32`.
- `generateMap(rows, cols, obstacleProbability = 0.3)` — fills a grid randomly (path/obstacle), places a single Exit on the border, and retries (up to 100 attempts) until the map is connected. Returns `{ grid, exit }`.
- `isConnected(grid, rows, cols)` — flood fill from any path cell; true iff every non-obstacle cell is reachable. This is the connectivity check that backs the "done when" criterion.

`src/main.js` (modified):

- Import `generateMap`, the constants, and `CellType`.
- Set the canvas to `GRID_COLS * CELL_SIZE` by `GRID_ROWS * CELL_SIZE`.
- Generate a map, then render each cell as a rectangle (`rect(CELL_SIZE - 2, CELL_SIZE - 2)` at `pos(c * CELL_SIZE + 1, r * CELL_SIZE + 1)`), colored by type — path = gray, obstacle = black, exit = green (placeholder colors; icons come later).

Done when: reloading the page shows a new random, fully-connected grid each time, with a green Exit on the border and no console errors. Connectivity is guaranteed by the retry loop in `generateMap`.
items.before: `src/main.js` only imports KAPLAY and calls `kaplay()`, showing a blank canvas. There is no map model, no generator, and no grid rendering.
